stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can it all have some air?

stations.title: Home page
stations.text: Notes touch their edges, parts run together.

captions: Dilys says the page feels crammed, like a shelf the night before a sale.
The notes touch their edges, and the three parts run into each other.
You add padding and a border to the notes, margin to the sections, and box-sizing.
The shop sits apart from its neighbours, with room to read.
Same page, same words. Now it has the colours, the letters and the space of the studio.
